niche.habitat: Hydrothermal vent plains & iron-sulfide mudflats. Evolves here because vent plumes obscure geographic landmarks & 38 PSU conductivity amplifies bio-voltages. Magnetotactic symbionts & ampullary organs exploit the dense ionic medium to track prey & navigate stable crustal anomaly corridors.
niche.diet: Conductive fluid grazers, magnetotactic bacterial colonies, electro-receptive invertebrates

body: Low-profile armored carapace, ampullary electroreceptor snout, magnetotactic gut symbionts as internal compass, radial feeding appendages.

Ampullary organs sense induced potential shifts

skill.effect: Reveals prey voltage signatures, hunting range +50m

chains.weakness: Saturated by high-salinity pools; player can dump conductive salts to blind it.

journal.en: It tastes the current in the mud.

relations.note: (council kind 'Competitor') Juveniles of Cromabuceo drop to vent plains; adults hunt dropped juveniles when magnetotactic plumes overlap.
(council kind 'Predator') Adults ambush juvenile Cromavolante when they descend to feed on vent microplankton.
(council kind 'Symbiont') Magnetotactic colonies provide internal compass & dietary iron, traded for stable gut pH.

temperament: Patient, ambush, highly reactive to conductivity gradients.
secrets: Gut symbionts can be harvested as living compass needles; they align to the player's magnetic skill.
Courtship involves two specimens linking arms to form a galvanic circuit, pulsing in sync with the planetary dynamo.
moments: When the auroral flares hit, the mudflats glow not with light, but with invisible tension. Its armored back shivers as the field lines rewrite themselves above it, and it adjusts its plates like a camera focusing on a ghost.

journal.en: It hunts by the planet's pulse.
Iron in its gut, iron on its back, iron in the mud.
